deploy-bot: STARTED staggered broadcast deploy to production — services: runtime, api, console. tag=release/2026.03.20-rc4 commit=ab12c3d
wave=1 targets: runtime (canary), api (canary), console (pinned->v2.3.1) :rocket:

amanda: copying release notes to #release-notes
sam: noted, watching api canary logs for 502s and token errors
jun: holding on console pin - need one more quick smoke from QA
rita: QA passed console canary earlier, we can go if ops are happy :eyes:

deploy-bot: WAVE 1 COMPLETE — runtime: ok (latency green), api: degraded (502 x12) -> auto-retry, console: pinned success
leo: api 502s look like upstream rate limiting, autoscaler didn't spin fast enough, investigating
amanda: rollback threshold is 5% errors; api at ~3% now but trending up
sam: recommend PAUSE before wave2 until autoscaler fix applied
jun: ack. pausing rollout. set rollout to PAUSED @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT PAUSED by sam at 2111112265. Next action: ops to apply hotfix or reduce initial concurrency
rita: pushed temporary autoscaler tweak, rolling patch to api infra now
deploy-bot: PATCH DEPLOYED to api infra commit=fix/autoscale-9a

deploy-bot: RESUMING rollout (wave2) at 2111112330 — targets: runtime replica expansion, api additional nodes, console finalization
sam: monitoring metrics and traces
leo: api error rate back to 0.4% after patch, scaling responding
amanda: console final smoke: UI + auth + deploy CLI checks all green :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETE. All services at tag release/2026.03.20-rc4. Summary:
- runtime: OK — latency stable
- api: OK — transient errors resolved after autoscaler patch
- console: OK — pinned v2.3.1 rolled to targets

jun: leaving note in release ticket: paused mid-rollout for autoscaler fix, resumed after patch, no rollback required
amanda: tagging release notes and notifying customers via status update
sam: thanks team — great quick response :clap:
